Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit first supplied image. Remove every animal from this board: ALL lizards, insects, beetles, animal turnarounds and animal size comparisons. There are NO animals in this book. Keep dune, notched rock, grains and location key only. Rearrange the retained objects cleanly to use the removed animal space. Preserve gentle long left slope and steep short right slope, flat contour style. Only sand, rock, sky, cloud and sun; no humans or living subjects.
Preserve original frozen specifications:
Use case: illustration-story. PRODUCTION REFERENCE SHEET, landscape, not a finished book page. Bold clean clear 2D children's cartoon throughout, crisp continuous dark outlines, flat clean colors, restrained smooth cel shading, no painted or grainy texture, no gouache, no embossed relief, no 3D. Original friendly readable illustration. Ordinary neutral settings; no flags, religious/political symbols or costumes. No logos, text, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, captions, watermarks or page borders. Natural anatomy and coherent hand/prop contact. Essential content at least 8 percent inside every edge.
 No named child cast: Kit and Zoe MUST NOT appear. Include unnamed human workers/adults ONLY when explicitly required by this particular scene; otherwise show only the natural subjects. Preserve exact reference identity and clothing.
Book: The Moving Dune; World Discovery; nonfiction.
Setting: One illustrative unvegetated sand dune in bright daylight, shown from the same side through a period of prevailing left-to-right wind. Generic example, not a named park or universal dune shape. A fixed dark bedrock outcrop sits in the foreground outside the migrating sand path.
Design locks for the book's recurring subjects/props (NOT a visibility list; never insert later objects/states prematurely): Tan sand dune with long gentle left slope and short steep right slope; Fixed charcoal bedrock outcrop with two notches, always foreground left; Small magnified grain inset only on pages 2–4; diagram grains not oversized real boulders
 Create a clean separated reference board on white: show the principal recurring props/animals in front, side and three-quarter views, their relative scale beside one another, and a single simple location key showing the persistent setting and daylight/palette. No humans, children, silhouettes, people, or human scale figures anywhere on this reference sheet. Show only the subjects this book requires. Use initial object states: Opening position; no wind arrows or apparent movement yet.. For orientation, the opening location/action is: Side view of dune with gentle left slope, steep right face and fixed notched rock in foreground.. Do not show a completed craft or later scene merely because the finished object is listed in design locks. No future story events, no captions.
Nature-only reference requirement: ABSOLUTELY NO HUMAN FIGURES anywhere, including scale guides. Compare only the natural subjects and setting. Use flat filled contour shapes throughout land, sand, sky and celestial surfaces, never brushed, grainy, speckled, painted or photorealistic texture.

visualReview.note: Directly viewed generated source and installed WebP. Nature-only dune reference contains no invented animals or humans. Long gentle left slope, short steep right slope, stable dark notched outcrop and magnified lifeless sand grains; flat contour colors.
